banner.standard.name: The Standard Well
banner.standard.blurb: Everything the well has ever swallowed, handed back one item at a time and in no particular order.
banner.featured.name: Featured Banner
banner.featured.blurb: One set is on the well's mind this week, and three of every four set pieces it returns will belong to it.
banner.pet.name: Pet Banner
banner.pet.blurb: Fewer trinkets, more eggs — something down there has taken up husbandry and would like you to know it.
well.line.0: I have been down here a very long time. You would be astonished what floats.
well.line.1: The odds are on the board. I insisted on that. The tavern wanted a curtain.
well.line.2: Everyone wishes for the same six things, so I have learned to keep the same six things in stock.
well.line.3: Coins go down, oddments come up. That is the entire arrangement, and it is posted by the bucket.
well.line.4: No wish is too small for me. Several have been, mind you.
well.line.5: Something down here sorts the returns by rarity. I have chosen not to look into it.
